detailed_description: The Terms of Service Generator creates a plain text terms template from a small browser-side form. You can enter website name, website URL, company name, contact email, and governing law country, then optionally include sections for user-generated content, subscriptions, and refunds. The Generate button fills a markdown-style textarea with a general template and the Copy button copies that output. The generated text includes an explicit reminder to review and customize it and consult a legal professional. The tool does not provide legal advice, guarantee compliance with GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA or other laws, offer industry templates, use jurisdiction maps, generate cookie banners, insert arbitration options, produce DOCX files, or track legal changes.
usage_steps: Enter the website name, website URL, company name, contact email, and governing law country.
Select whether the template should include user-generated content, subscription, or refund sections.
Click Generate to create the markdown-style terms template.
Review and edit the generated text for your situation.
Copy the output when you are ready to move it into another editor for legal review.
usage_examples: Draft a starting terms template for a small website before professional review.
Include a basic user-generated content section when a site accepts submissions.
Add simple subscription and refund language for a product prototype.
Copy the generated markdown-style text into a document for manual editing.
